part.text:
The fix is complete. Changes in `src/parser.y` (with regenerated `src/parser.c`):

- **`Pattern`**: added `'$' Keyword` so `as $label`, `reduce ... as $if`, etc. work (src/parser.y:968)
- **`ObjPat`**: added `'$' Keyword` and `'$' Keyword ':' Pattern` for destructuring like `. as {$label} | $label` and `. as {a: $break}` (src/parser.y:999, 1005)
- **`MkDictPair`**: added `'$' Keyword ':' ExpD` for `{$label: value}` object construction (src/parser.y:1115)
- **`label` binding**: added `"label" '$' Keyword '|' Exp` (src/parser.y:498) and `BREAK '$' Keyword` (src/parser.y:767) so `label $if | ... break $if` works

All keywords (via the existing `Keyword` nonterminal) are now accepted after `$` in every binding context. Bison reports no new grammar conflicts, and `make check` passes all 7 test suites (712/712), including the new keyword-binding tests in tests/jq.test.
